label: CALENDAR_CONCENTRATION_AND_EX_2020
method: Independent interval-weighted decomposition of the frozen per-calendar-year joint log losses. Task 17 arithmetic was not relied upon; the decomposition was recomputed from stability.calendar and reconciled against the frozen paired delta.

reconciliation.note: Agreement to 2.7e-15 confirms the per-year aggregates are the exact components of the frozen headline delta.

concentration.negative_year: 2021 (-0.00608), the only evaluation year in which M2 is better than M1 on joint log loss
concentration.note: 2020 carries 20.8% of evaluation intervals and 89.3% of the headline delta.

two_ex_2020_quantities.note: Two distinct quantities have both been called 'ex-2020' and they are not interchangeable. Task 17 reported the first; the Task 18 brief asks for the second.

contribution_residual.definition: Full-period weighted mean minus 2020's contribution, still divided by the full interval total.
contribution_residual.interpretation: How much of the reported headline delta is attributable to non-2020 years.

renormalised_ex_2020_evaluation_delta.definition: Interval-weighted M2-M1 delta over the seven non-2020 years with weights renormalised to that subpopulation.
renormalised_ex_2020_evaluation_delta.interpretation: The difference that would be observed had the evaluation excluded calendar 2020.

two_ex_2020_quantities.correction: Task 17's figure is arithmetically correct for the contribution residual but was described in the hostile review as 'the ex-2020 residual delta', which reads as the ex-2020 evaluation result. The ex-2020 evaluation delta is +0.00217, not +0.00172. The manuscript must state which quantity it reports.

relative_magnitude.note: 18.1% relative deterioration full period against 2.8% excluding calendar 2020.

year_block_sensitivity.method: Percentile resample of calendar-year blocks performed on frozen per-year aggregates, 20,000 draws, seed 61802. This is an aggregate-level approximation of the frozen interval-level calendar block bootstrap, not the same computation.

validation_full_period.verdict: The aggregate method reproduces the frozen interval closely: upper bounds agree to 2e-05 and both lower bounds sit at zero to within 3e-04. The method is therefore adequate for sensitivity use ex-2020.

ex_2020.coverage_caveat: Only seven annual blocks remain, one of them a partial 2026. Percentile coverage is weak. This interval is sensitivity information and is explicitly not offered as frequentist inference.

permitted_and_supported: The temporal deterioration is highly concentrated in calendar 2020, which supplies 89.3% of the headline delta.
The deterioration is not exclusive to 2020: six of the seven remaining years retain positive deltas.
The full-period magnitude is not representative of a typical evaluation year: 18.1% relative deterioration full period against 2.8% excluding 2020.
2021 reverses sign, with M2 better than M1 on joint log loss.
prohibited_and_not_asserted: The deterioration is exclusively a pandemic artifact.
interpretation.task11_distinction_preserved: Task 11 recorded H7 'Pandemic alone explains failure' as NOT_SUPPORTED, and that remains correct: direction persists outside 2020. Task 18 adds the magnitude statement Task 11 did not make, namely that the deterioration is pandemic-DOMINATED. Pandemic-only explanation and pandemic-dominated magnitude are different claims and both findings stand together.

status_reason: The per-year decomposition reconciles to the frozen delta to 2.7e-15, the 89.3% concentration is independently verified, and the ex-2020 quantity is computed under both definitions with the conflation corrected.
